evidencePolicy: Only completed human review, pilot, calibration, standard-setting, security, privacy and release-approval evidence may advance a release gate. Repository structure, generated files, machine contracts, synthetic records, passing CI, course completion or deployment alone must not close a human/validation/release gate.
requiredEvidence: validated job-task analysis and SME/employer validation
new secure operational item bank in an approved private assessment store
approved secure assessment delivery/store implementation evidence
equivalent secure credential forms and equivalence evidence
explicit versioned final program release approval
prohibitedShortcuts: Do not treat green CI as certification approval.
Do not treat a machine-built policy/contract as approval of the real operational system.
Do not use public ITEM-TECH1 or other public development items as the secure operational credential bank.
Do not create synthetic human review, pilot, calibration, inter-rater, standard-setting or approval evidence to close gates.
Do not expose secure operational answer keys, credential forms, candidate evidence or signing secrets in the public repository.
Do not issue the credential while any required release gate is unresolved.
authorityBoundary: This ledger preserves program-specific historical/checklist gates. It must not override exact-version evidence-derived certification readiness from the certification evidence reconciler.
